description: NaCaGdSeO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent GdO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Ca is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent GdO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Ca-O bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Gd is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form GdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SeO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Gd-O bond lengths are 2.21 Å. Se is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GdO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.81 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, one Gd, and one Se atom.
